scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.dev:local: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state -e local
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply ip-assess -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply ip-assess -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
